entities.name: Huang Chao Rebellion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Huang Chao Rebellion, a transformative movement in China (763–907). Emerged from Lushan Rebellion — one of the deadliest conflicts in human history and Battle of Talas — Tang defeated by Abbasids; papermaking spreads westward. Catalyzed Late Tang Decline.
